# Parley v0.1.14

This test beta brings the installed application up to date with Parley's
vendor-driven cross-vendor coordination direction and the redesigned native
workbench.

## Cross-vendor coordination

- Adds authenticated `whoami`, pane discovery and bounded coordination events
  without exposing terminal text, prompts, results, folders or credentials.
- Adds official per-launch vendor hook adapters where the vendor CLI supports
  them. Unsupported state remains visibly Unknown.
- Adds recoverable Ask ids, bounded agent-declared delegation progress and
  reviewed substantial results through `parley done --file`.
- Adds Challenge and Verify review actions, person-owned verdicts and linked
  handoff lineage without introducing a second workflow model.
- Adds Command-Shift-A for reviewed delivery of the active Ghostty selection
  and Command-Shift-J for exact-pane attention navigation.

## Workbench and visibility

- Adds the native Task Manager with bounded pane-owned process, CPU, memory and
  listening-port attribution.
- Adds concise workspace facts for pane folders, Git state, ports, roles,
  profiles and authoritative attention.
- Reworks Status Center around Live, Results, History, Agents and Health.
- Consolidates stacked banners into one prioritized notice lane while keeping
  every permission, failure, stale-protocol and shared-worktree fact reachable.
- Simplifies pane rows and collaboration chrome, increases text legibility and
  uses semantic colors consistently.
- Replaces several picker alerts with native selection sheets and adds a
  growing reviewed composer with an explicit size limit.
- Adds a shared Terminal Appearance panel with explicit Parley overrides and an
  allowlisted import of Ghostty fonts, themes, palettes and colors.

## Workspace and companion improvements

- Completes folderless and multi-folder workspace behavior while preserving
  pane-local working directories and permission review.
- Expands the VS Code companion with capability negotiation, explicit context
  composition, an in-memory Context Basket, content-free collaboration status,
  recovery guidance and correlated native preview acknowledgement.
- Removes the unreleased Research Board and separate Handoff Chains surfaces;
  their useful review and evidence capabilities now use ordinary handoffs,
  Status Center, Context Packs and Workspace Briefs.

## Upgrade notes

- Quit Parley before replacing the existing application. Quitting ends its live
  pane processes and app-resident coordination core.
- Workspace definitions, folder attachments, layouts and collaboration history
  remain compatible.
- The shared agent protocol is now v14. Existing panes from v0.1.13 must restart
  before using the new coordination commands; a full application upgrade
  naturally recreates agent panes as stopped placeholders.

## Install and trust

- Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
- At least one supported, installed and signed-in vendor CLI.
- Download `Parley-0.1.14-mac-arm64.dmg`, quit Parley, replace `Parley.app`
  in Applications, and reopen it from Finder.
- This test beta is ad-hoc signed and is **not notarized**. After first trying to
  open it, use **System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway** only when
  the files came from this expected GitHub release. Never disable Gatekeeper.
- Automatic replacement and the Homebrew cask are intentionally unavailable
  for this test beta.

Use `Parley-0.1.14-mac-arm64.SHA256SUMS` to verify every downloaded artifact.
